name: v16 Full-Model & OmniQuant Baseline Protocol Audit
attention: sdpa for all M0-M3 using native Qwen2 forward; use_cache=False; TF32=False; eval mode
quantized_scope: all 168 decoder linears; embeddings/tied lm_head/norms/biases remain FP16

search.unit: per output row, one shared alpha over all G128 groups
search.prefix: self-method selected quantized weights, true sequential native group order
search.candidates: complete independent dynamic GPTQ from pristine current target W and common initial Hinv
search.loss: mean square of X_FP32 @ (Q_FP16.float()-W_FP16.float()).T, calibration only
search.loss_primary: direct projection in token chunks; Gram equivalent allowed only after real-X checks and ranking check
search.tie: lowest measured loss; exact ties prefer largest alpha

omni.name: OmniQuant-Qwen2.5 port, official W4A16 weight-only configuration
omni.optimizer: AdamW + official AMP GradScaler, original fixed order/no shuffle/no LR schedule
omni.objective: official MSELoss(block output of original FP prefix, quant block output of quant prefix)

primary_representation: FP16 dense dequantized weights for all methods, mathematical quality comparison, no compression/latency claim
packing: separate secondary GPTQ packed export with exact integer-code and layout verification; not assumed equal to dense FP16 candidate
formal_launch: only after next implementation/one-block smoke gates and empirical cost review; this audit stops
output_restriction: all v16 files in this directory; v8-v15 immutable
